title: Siman 224
section: His Journey and Residence in Uman

segments.he: (מ) כשהיה שוכב וגונח גניחות הרבה מאד. אחר כך ענה ואמר אין זה שיך לי כלל רק אחד עומד ומכה והוא במקום שהוא:
segments.en: (40.) When he was lying and groaning with many great groans — afterwards he answered and said: "This has nothing to do with me at all — only one stands and strikes, and he is in his place."
